name: io.github.chrischall/schoolpass-mcp
description: SchoolPass for Claude — students, arrival/dismissal calendar, pickup changes, and school info

environmentVariables.name: SCHOOLPASS_EMAIL
environmentVariables.description: Your SchoolPass parent account email address.

environmentVariables.name: SCHOOLPASS_SCHOOL_CODE
environmentVariables.description: The numeric school id (AppCode) SchoolPass uses to select your school.

environmentVariables.name: SCHOOLPASS_API_HOST
environmentVariables.description: Optional regional API host override (default busapi-east16-ss.school-pass.net).

environmentVariables.name: SCHOOLPASS_TIMEZONE
environmentVariables.description: The school's IANA timezone (e.g. America/New_York), used for the "today" default of the calendar and pickup-change reads. Defaults to the server's local zone; set it when the server runs elsewhere (a hosted server runs in UTC, so evening defaults would otherwise point at tomorrow).

environmentVariables.name: SCHOOLPASS_SESSION_CACHE
environmentVariables.description: Set to false to disable the on-disk session cache and re-authenticate on every process start. Defaults to enabled.

environmentVariables.name: SCHOOLPASS_SESSION_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Absolute path for the session cache file. Defaults to $MCP_DATA_DIR/.schoolpass-mcp/session.json.
